I replied to Tobias in a thread on their #central-team message: "Thanks, Tobias. Noted: 382 seats for the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal."

They said no action was needed, so that reply is the only thing I did. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so the channel was a fine place to confirm it. I didn't check the 382 against any contract or other file.
